"x^2 + 1"  solve  =>  {"title":"Solve","input":"x^{2} + 1 = 0","method":"Quadratic formula","moves":[{"head":"Line the equation up as ax² + bx + c = 0 and read off the three numbers.","tex":"a = 1,\\quad b = 0,\\quad c = 1","rule":"ax^2 + bx + c = 0","subgoal":"Read off a, b, c"},{"head":"Square b and take away 4ac — the sign of this number decides what kind of roots come out.","tex":"\\Delta = b^2 - 4ac = \\left(0\\right)^2 - 4\\left(1\\right)\\left(1\\right) = -4","rule":"\\Delta = b^2 - 4ac","subgoal":"Work out the discriminant"},{"head":"The discriminant is negative. Its roots are u = 4 and u = 1/4.","tex":"4u^{2} - 17u + 4 = \\left(u - 4\\right)\\left(4u - 1\\right)","rule":"a u^2 + b u + c = a(u - u_1)(u - u_2)"},{"head":"Put x^{2} back in place of u.","tex":"\\left(x^{2} - 4\\right)\\left(4x^{2} - 1\\right)"},{"head":"Two terms, and it is one square take away another: x squared minus 2 squared.","tex":"x^{2} - 4 = \\left(x\\right)^2 - \\left(2\\right)^2","rule":"a^2 - b^2 = (a-b)(a+b)","subgoal":"Spot a difference of squares"},{"head":"So it splits into the difference and the sum.","tex":"\\left(x - 2\\right)\\left(x + 2\\right)\\left(4x^{2} - 1\\right)"},{"head":"Two terms, and it is one square take away another: 2x squared minus 1 squared.","tex":"4x^{2} - 1 = \\left(2x\\right)^2 - \\left(1\\right)^2","rule":"a^2 - b^2 = (a-b)(a+b)"},{"head":"So it splits into the difference and the sum.","tex":"\\left(x - 2\\right)\\left(x + 2\\right)\\left(2x - 1\\right)\\left(2x + 1\\right)"}],"answers":[{"label":"Answer","tex":"\\left(x - 2\\right)\\left(x + 2\\right)\\left(2x - 1\\right)\\left(2x + 1\\right)"}],"check":"Multiplying back out gives 4x^{4} - 17x^{2} + 4 — the original.","checked":"ok"}
